table.name: TLGNR_TRSP_ZONE_BS
table.description: Transport Zone as known in SAP and used by certain material conditions for bag products which are defined for a zone. The geographical definition (polygon areas) are defined in Logon and stored in tlgnc_trsp_zone_polygon/vertex.

column.name: TRSP_ZONE_CD
column.description: PK. Identifier for the transport zone, e.g. CH-A00, AT-A02. The list of zone identifiers is taken from SAP. If a new one is added, it is added simultaneously in SAP and Logon, before it can be used in material price conditions or transport cost conditions.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
